assets.name: greenhouse
assets.prompt:
Create an original production illustration asset for Vigor, a greenhouse management workspace, using the attached image ONLY as a STYLE reference for its finely crafted miniature diorama, soft orthographic three-quarter view, material fidelity, and clear human activity. Replace the entire office subject with a small modern Indonesian greenhouse. This is a new standalone illustrated scene, not a screenshot or interface mockup.

Asset: main login illustration. Landscape 3:2 composition, transparent background with genuine alpha. Show the entire isolated miniature on a thin pale cool-white plinth, with generous transparent margins and nothing clipped. Orthographic viewpoint from slightly above, front-left, around 30 degrees elevation, entire scene sharp.
Subject: a believable compact greenhouse with a slim galvanized structural frame and translucent pale green polycarbonate, cut away on the near side so carefully arranged raised crop beds are visible. Tomato vines on slender supports toward the rear, leafy lettuce beds at front, narrow central walking aisle. A female farm operator in muted forest-green workwear, dark trousers and simple boots examines a leaf; a male staff member with a small tablet stands by the entry. Human figures have natural miniature proportions and calm purposeful poses, faces discreet. At one side: a squat water reservoir, small pump and filter manifold with orderly teal pipework and one compact controller cabinet. At the front: a simple packing bench, two reusable harvest crates with a few tomatoes, a seedling tray and hand trowel. One trap card and a small fixed camera can be spotted within the structure. Keep equipment modest and plausible for an affordable small farm.
Material and palette: ceramic-like matte paint, fine brushed galvanized metal, lightly translucent greenhouse panels, convincingly modelled leaves, soft contact shadows. Forest #1D593F, leaf #73A15C, sage #EAF2EB, water teal #357E88, cool white #FFFFFF and ink #20352B. Tomato red is a small natural produce accent. Carefully controlled soft studio daylight from upper-left. Premium designed miniature with precise geometry and tactile construction, friendly but not childish. Avoid plastic gloss, neon, glows, gradients as decoration, floating UI panels, futuristic robots, magic sparkles, office computers, oversized heads, money symbols, generic sustainability icons. No text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, arrows or labels anywhere. A single coherent scene, not multiple panels.
